Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (boost, external Schottky diode), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (None) on SOT-23-5.
Re-verify switching frequency (1000 kHz), inductor value (10 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (1.233 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
